text: Looper/swaying caterpillar (ដង្កូវយោលទោង): described as the most serious insect pest of this crop, feeding on and destroying leaf tissue to the point that it can cause up to 100% loss if unmanaged. In Cambodia, damage is heaviest from late January through May, declining outside that window. Recommended control approach: monitor for the adult moth's presence in the field — once moths are observed flying over the crop, growers are advised to take timely action rather than waiting until larval leaf damage is already visible.
